text:
Mira: Heads-up — vendor pen test next Thurs. Need final scope, evidence handoff, and a rollback corridor plan. Can we confirm who owns RBAC changes and KMS access windows?
Dan: I can own RBAC change approvals. Will need list of principals and exact times for ephemeral roles.
Santosh: For KMS, prefer granting decrypt-only via proxy for evidence export. No long-lived keys. We should use presigned S3 links for the artifacts.
Mira: Good. Also need audit-log exports. Can we snapshot SIEM indices for the window and seal them?
Dan: Yes — plan: snapshot at start, end, and hourly deltas. We'll sign the manifests with GPG and store checksums in the evidence bucket.
Santosh: Note: our KMS proxy supports HSM-wrapped keys. Ops: can we open a 3hr window for ephemeral decrypt roles on the 14th 15:00-18:00 UTC?
ops-bot: Ops oncall rota: @Liam is assigned for 2023-08-14 15:00-18:00 UTC window. A ticket has been created: https://jira.company/RED-1234
Mira: Can we include rollback corridor steps in case a test triggers infra changes? Need a ticket-level rollback playbook.
Dan: Rollback playbook outline: 1) Revoke ephemeral roles 2) Revert any infra IaC merges 3) Trigger read-only mode + temporary rate-limits 4) Notify customers via status page
Santosh: Also: blacklist the assessor IPs in firewall if they go rogue. We'll collect pcap only with approval.
Mira: Evidence checklist draft:
- presigned artifact links
- signed manifests (sha256)
- ephemeral-role audit log
- SIEM snapshot
- record of KMS proxy grants
- list of commands run
Please review.
Dan: LGTM. Add a SHA256 manifest for each artifact and a simple validator script:
```
#!/bin/bash
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256 || echo "mismatch"
```
Mira: Who will perform the certification QA and sign-off?
Santosh: I'll coordinate QA with Product Security. We need 1 business-day turnaround for triage before retest.
Mira: Retest slots are requested for Mon/Tue next week, prefer morning UTC. Can we lock them after triage?
Dan: Yes — tentatively block Mon 09:00-12:00 UTC and Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC.
ops-bot: Created runbook doc: https://internal.docs/pt-runbooks/rollback-corridor
Mira: Action items:
- Dan: RBAC approval flow + manifest signing
- Santosh: KMS proxy grant + evidence packaging
- Liam: Ops oncall for window + firewall rules
- Mira: coordinate assessor handshake + JIRA
Santosh: I'll add steps to KMS playbook for ephemeral grant revocation.
Dan: I'll prepare a yara/hash-based whitelist to quickly validate artifacts.
Mira: Thanks. If nothing else, we'll do a quick pre-pt dry run tomorrow 16:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Liam: I'll be there. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Reminder: submit evidence retention policy for reviewer — default 90 days unless enterprise exception.
Mira: Noted. End of thread.
